v: How much more does a one-bedroom in the Calgary area cost than in twenty twenty?
In October twenty twenty, CMHC's survey put the average one-bedroom rent at one thousand and eighty-six dollars a month.
By October twenty twenty-five: one thousand five hundred and eighty-one.
That's four hundred and ninety-five dollars more every month. Up about forty-six per cent.
The biggest jump came in twenty twenty-three. In twenty twenty-five, it levelled off.
